# Niddesavāra (Ne 3)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Niddesavāra* ("Demonstrative Subsection", Nett 3,8–5,7) is a structural subsection of the *Nettippakaraṇa*, following the *Uddesavāra* [von Hinüber 1996; SuttaCentral]. It sets out the sixteen *hāras* ("modes of conveying") and the five *nayas* ("guide-lines"), followed by an enumeration of twelve *padas* ("terms"), of which six relate to linguistic form (*vyañjana*) and six to meaning (*attha*) [von Hinüber 1996]. This group of twelve terms constitutes a *sutta* comprising the entire utterance of the Buddha [von Hinüber 1996]. The closing verses of the *Niddesavāra* synthesize these categories, showing how the *nayas* and *padas* correlate with meaning (*attha*) and form [von Hinüber 1996]. The verses presented in the *Niddesavāra* serve as a foundational template for the subsequent *Paṭiniddesa* (specifically the *Hāravibhaṅga*), which quotes each respective verse and illustrates it using textual examples drawn from the Suttapiṭaka [von Hinüber 1996].
SuttaCentral records passage-level parallels between the *Niddesavāra* and another section of the *Netti*, the *Samāropanahāravibhaṅga* (Ne 19), as well as two chapters of the *Peṭakopadesa*: the *Hāravibhaṅgapañcamabhūmi* (Pe 5) and the *Suttavebhaṅgiya* (Pe 9) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus confirms these connections with the *Peṭakopadesa*, identifying shared text between Ne 3 (§4.4–5.4) and Pe 5 (§25.1–26.4), as well as Ne 3 (§18.2–20.3) and Pe 9 (§58.2–60.3) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus identifies 107 matches across seven Pali texts, showing extensive reuse in exegetical and subcommentarial literature, most prominently the *Nettivibhāvinī* (44 matches), the *Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-ṭīkā* (25 matches), the *Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaabhinavaṭīkā*, the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
